articles.summary: EWING, N.J.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Universal Display Corporation (UDC) (Nasdaq: OLED), a global leader in energy-efficient OLED technologies and materials, today announced that Dr. Julie Brown, Executive Vice President and Chief Technical Officer, has been honored with the IEEE Frederik Philips Award, recognizing her outstanding accomplishments and “leadership in the development of materials and technologies for phosphorescent Organic Light Emitting Diode (OLED) displays used in consumer electronics.”
articles.title: Universal Display Corporation’s Dr. Julie Brown Receives Prestigious IEEE Frederik Philips Award
